interpretation: Upstream exec saves the old mm high-water RSS into signal->maxrss;getrusage takes that saved maximum as well as the current mm high-water. This is consistent with inherited launcher/address-space history surviving exec in ru_maxrss while post-exec VmHWM reflects the current mm. The running kernel binary/source build was not reconstructed;the paired empirical observations are retained separately.
decision: Do not rewrite prior raw memory. Future frozen wrappers should report both full-child lifetime RSS and post-exec process-stage VmHWM/VmRSS. Keep matched launch context and original qualified memory/timing requirements.
